subject: lol, I didn't actually mean
author: Segaswirl
body:
lol, I didn't actually mean to post that in here... (sorry psyche).

 

I'm not a Nintendo hardcore fan, I was just saying that the hardcore fans that buy into all their Metroids and Zelda's must be livid. I've never been into Nintendo at all really... I have a cube, but the only reason I bought that was for the Dreamcast ports. Nintendo are the masters of milking franchises, but their main fans are probably the most fanatical there is. 🎮

subject: But I thought that was your point...
author: SUFFUR
body:
some where, cross blogging is a game in itself.😉

That we were just getting upgraded versions of just the same game? And game type?  Though a new Zelda Story would be nice.

 

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?

subject: What was that?
author: Segaswirl
body:
I think Nintendo's hardcore fans must be pretty pissed right now. No new Metriod, Zelda... no big hitters at all... just casual crap that was pretty similar to the stuff that took up about 30 - 40% of Microsofts conference. I know I said I was fed up with gaming and all it's endless sequels, but all this talk of DS cooking guides and dancing about the living room like an idiot pretending to play a guitar doesn't interest me much either... 😈

 

I'm not a Sony fan, infact I think the PlayStation 3 as a whole is a bit... shit. But i'm kinda wanting to see them show  something unique and interesting... but judging from their past 3 years at E3 I don't have much hope for them.

subject: 1vs100?....
author: PsychedelicBabe
body: 🤷Ive just been reading about the 1Vs100 game and its confused me no end.....as much as i like the idea of the game and the way that use your avatar im confused as to how the game will actually work especially seeing as they are giving out cash prizes for the winners.....for a start it states that there is a $1,000,000 prize for the winner....so does this mean that only the americans are getting this game?....AGAIN....and also how will it work?.. i mean how many people play xbox live?....and how many people are going to jump at the chance of winning a cash prize?.....exactly so how are they going to do it?.....and are Microsoft going to charge for this game?....i think if they do it will cause people in general not to buy it because they might stand the chance of never getting the oppurtunity to play for the big prize?......see why i found it confusing.....i hate the way they release these games and not give you sufficient vital information on the game......it becomes frustrating....if anyone can shed any light on this id be very happy....as i think the idea is there and it could be brilliant.....🤷http://www.nbc.com/1vs100/about/ take a look im not sure judging by the content whether us brits will get it but we might it did originate in the Netherlands and its also going to other countries so imo it would be a travesty if us brits couldnt participate.....i also think the questions would be tricky as theyd probably be American trivial questions.....😛....and ive played a few American Trivial games online and im telling you the questions are crazy.🌹

subject: Awww  Garrrsh
author: oO EezO Oo
body:
😳😃😳 As the ever so wiseful and full of brainishness Goofy would say "Aw Garrsh".  Yup, that Netters is a cool chick, I'm usually ace professional at making a fool of myself, and I think thats why we get along so well 🙂. 

For the longest time I thought those music rhythm games were a joke but when you can get together with some people who don't mind being a goofball they're alot of fun.  I even thought the singing parts in RockBand were going to be really stupid, but if everyones taking a turn, and acting like idiots, its a good time.  Of coarse, a little liquid courage or talent juice makes things alot more interesting but yeah, Its kind of fun acting like a complete idiot sometimes (or all the time if your gamertag says EeZo in it somewhere)
